# HandleAdornment

- Inherits [`Adornment`](adornment.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("HandleAdornment")`
- **Abstract**: it cannot be created; other classes inherit from it

The base class of the shapes placed by a `CFrame` on their adornee: boxes, spheres, cylinders, cones, lines and images.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AlwaysOnTop` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the shape is drawn over everything. When it is off, objects in front of it hide it. |
| `CFrame` | `CFrame` | `CFrame.identity` | read/write | Where the shape is, relative to the adornee: its middle, and how it is turned. |
| `ZIndex` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The order of the shapes drawn over everything, from 0 to 10: a higher one is drawn over a lower one, and of two with the same, the nearer. |
